name: ai.dincat/dincat
title: DinCat — learning and life in Japan
description: Learning and life in Japan: take-home pay, visa rule summaries and ready-made question pages.

tools.name: list_library
tools.description: List DinCat's library of ready-made question pages, grouped by shelf: money (take-home pay, staying a dependent, year-end adjustment), visa and residence, Japanese certification exams (FP, IT Passport, Applied Information Technology Engineer), languages (Japanese, English, Chinese) and hard-to-say conversations at work. Each link opens that question in DinCat's chat; no sign-up is needed to try. Use search_library to look up a keyword.

lang.description: Language of the reply and of the linked pages: ja = Japanese, zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English. Use the user's language.

shelf.description: Only this shelf: money, visa, exam, lang or awkward. Omit for all shelves.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search DinCat's library of ready-made question pages by keyword, in the user's language (e.g. 手取り, 永住, 敬語, JLPT, 年末調整, 到手, take-home pay). Returns up to 8 pages with links that open the question in DinCat's chat; if nothing matches, returns the shelves instead.

lang.description: Language of the reply and of the linked pages: ja = Japanese, zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English. Use the user's language.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Describe what DinCat's assistant helps with (languages, salary and tax, visas, hard-to-say conversations, family check-ins, deep analysis, images) and how pricing works: a free daily chat allowance, per-message costs in cat food (counted in grams), cat food packs and monthly plans in yen. Figures come from the same settings the website uses.

lang.description: Language of the reply and of the linked pages: ja = Japanese, zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English. Use the user's language.

tools.name: calc_take_home_pay
tools.description: Calculate a company employee's take-home pay in Japan from the 2026 official rates: health, nursing-care, child-support, pension and employment insurance, income tax and resident tax, per month and per year, for the first year in Japan and for later years. Calculated by program, not AI. Give either monthlySalary or annualSalary. Age and prefecture default to 30 and Tokyo when not given (marked in the result). The inputs are not stored.

lang.description: Language of the reply and of the linked pages: ja = Japanese, zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English. Use the user's language.

monthlySalary.description: Monthly base pay in yen before deductions (額面), excluding commuting allowance. Give this or annualSalary.

annualSalary.description: Yearly gross pay in yen including bonuses, excluding commuting allowance. Give this or monthlySalary.

annualBonus.description: Total bonuses per year in yen (default 0). With annualSalary it is the part of that total paid as bonuses.

bonusPayments.description: How many times a year the bonus is paid (default 2).

monthlyCommute.description: Monthly commuting allowance in yen (default 0): not taxed, but counted for social insurance.

age.description: Age (default 30). From 40 to 64, nursing-care insurance is added.

prefecture.description: Prefecture where the user works (the health insurance rate depends on it), lowercase romaji, e.g. tokyo, osaka, kanagawa, aichi, fukuoka. Default tokyo.

industry.description: Employment insurance category: general (default), agriculture (agriculture, forestry, fisheries, sake brewing) or construction.

tools.name: get_visa_rules
tools.description: Get DinCat's summary of Japan's residence-status (visa) rules for one or more topics, compiled from official Immigration Services Agency pages, with the official sources. Information and self-check points only: it does not judge whether an application will be approved, and does not write or fill in application documents. Call without topics to list the topics.

lang.description: Language of the reply and of the linked pages: ja = Japanese, zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English. Use the user's language.

topics.description: Up to 4 topics: renewal = Extension of period of stay / change of status; fees = Fees (applications accepted from 2026-10-01); pr = Permanent residence; naturalization = Naturalization (Japanese nationality); job_change = Notifications after changing or leaving a job; student_work = From student to work; family_stay = Family / Dependent status; dependent = Dependent procedures (bringing family over, renewal); spouse_jp = Spouse of a Japanese national (status: Spouse or Child of Japanese National); spouse_pr = Spouse of a permanent resident (status: Spouse or Child of Permanent Resident); hire = First work visa for a foreign hire (company / HR); employer = Company / HR side (employing foreign staff); school = Japanese language school side (international students); short_stay = Temporary visitor (tourism, business trips, visiting family); referral = Cases to refer to professionals; dv = Domestic violence and visas. Omit to list the topics.
